components.text:
Creating a brew, infusion or potion is a simple process, requiring either a $(b)$(el:brewing/witch_cauldron)witch's cauldron$(/b)$(/el) or $(b)$(el:brewing/kettle)kettle$(/b)$(/el).

First, you must fill your $(b)$(el:brewing/witch_cauldron)cauldron$(/b)$(/el) or $(b)$(el:brewing/kettle)kettle$(/b)$(/el) with water from a bucket. You will know it is full if no more water can fit.
Next, place a heat source underneath your vessel such as fire, lava or a campfire. After a few seconds, the water should begin to boil.

The final step, after filling the vessel and waiting for it to boil, is to drop your ingredients into the vessel, in order, one by one.

The water should start to change colour. Once added, the brew needs to boil for a few seconds to finish.

If you make a mistake during brewing, such as adding the wrong ingredient or removing the heat source, your brew will $(b)spoil$(/b).

When spoiled, the brew will turn brown and need to be removed using an $(b)empty bucket$(/b).
